behavior: Only Privy access tokens with a fresh key list sign in, users have a capped number of profiles, and names can't hide text or pose as Forwend
acceptance: R-18, R-30: a token without sid or with linked_accounts (a Privy identity token) gets 401; when Privy can't be reached the last key list verifies for at most MaxKeyAge + KeyGrace (10 min), then nothing does; PRIVY_JWKS_URL must be https (loopback http for tests); a user has at most 10 profiles, enforced under a lock against concurrent requests; names, titles, notes, client and billing fields refuse control and invisible format characters (line breaks only in notes and addresses), and sender, profile and billing names that read as Forwend are refused; the pay page and the PDF say the sender's name is not checked; the checkout hides the address before it closes; backend, unit and e2e tests cover each; R-30, api.md and PROJECT.md (payer privacy) match
notes: 2026-10-11 review fail by reviewer: FAIL. (1) apps/backend/internal/profile/text.go:25 Impersonates lowercases before NFKD, so compatibility capitals fold to ASCII uppercase and are then dropped: '𝐅𝐨𝐫𝐰𝐞𝐧𝐝' (math bold) and 'ℱorwend' pass; Greek capitals Ε/Ν also pass ('FORWΕND', 'FORWEΝD') because their lowercase forms are not in the lookalike map. Fix: strings.ToLower(norm.NFKD.String(name)) and add ε->e, η/ν handling as needed, with test cases. (2) apps/backend/internal/profile/onboard.go:64 inserts profiles without the MaxProfiles check: SignUp + 9 POST /v1/profiles + POST /v1/me/onboarding {get_paid_by_clients, accept_business_payments} ends with 12 profiles (reproduced with an overlay test). Contradicts the acceptance 'at most 10 profiles' and docs/backend/api.md:59. Count under the same user lock in Onboard (refuse or skip) and test it. (3) apps/backend/internal/document/document.go:131 (sender block with 'not checked by Forwend') and :96 (PDF author = sender) have no test, although the acceptance says tests cover each; invoices_pdf_test.go has pdfText/mustContain to add one. Verified OK: keysFor KeyGrace in all branches (fresh, tried-recently within/after grace, fetch failure within/after grace, unknown kid -> error); sid required is safe (Privy docs list sid in access tokens, identity tokens have linked_accounts and no sid; the real-Privy web e2e in docs/runs/F127-20261011T152918Z-e2e.log passed 20/20); cap holds under concurrency (FOR UPDATE + count in its own statement) and replay at the cap returns the stored profile; PRIVY_JWKS_URL https check; Chromium FormData sends LF only for textareas so \r refusal does not hit the web forms; 5-min early close leaves 10 min on a 15-min invoice and the countdown uses the same time. Tests run: go test auth/config/profile/invoice/httpapi/document ok; vitest pay 12 passed; pnpm lint and typecheck ok.

2026-10-11 review pass by reviewer: PASS. The three earlier findings are fixed and checked again. (1) internal/profile/text.go: NFKD now runs before lowercasing, and capital look-alikes are mapped first. Probe: '𝐅𝐨𝐫𝐰𝐞𝐧𝐝', 'ℱorwend', 'FORWΕND', 'FORWEΝD' and fullwidth are refused. 'Forward End', Greek, Cyrillic and CJK names pass. PlainText now refuses U+2028/2029 and the blank fillers and keeps ZWNJ/ZWJ (Persian, emoji). (2) internal/profile/onboard.go:64 counts profiles under the user lock; an overlay test at 10 profiles refuses onboarding and leaves 10. (3) invoices_pdf_test.go checks a request without billing details prints FROM, the sender and 'Name not checked by Forwend'. Web copy now names hidden characters and the Forwend rule, the new-profile form shows the cap and name errors, and api.md matches. Checks I ran: go test on auth/config/profile/invoice/httpapi/document ok; vitest pay/profiles/invoices 25 passed; pnpm lint and typecheck ok. All logs of verify 2026-10-11T15:42:18Z pass; the e2e signs in with real Privy tokens (20 passed). Non-blocking: onboard.go:64 adds len(kinds) to the count, and that includes Personal, which onboarding never inserts. A user at 10 profiles is refused for receive_and_send alone, and a user at 9 for receive_and_send+get_paid_by_clients (reproduced). Only users who create profiles through the API before onboarding hit this, and skipping still works; count only freelancer and merchant. new-profile-form.tsx:54-55 picks the error by matching words in the message, the same pattern invalidField already uses.
